name: Scroll Progress Car
description: Reading page with a car fixed to the bottom edge that drives from left to right as the page scrolls, reaching the right edge at the end of the page.
contents: Header with eyebrow label and title
Heading and list of body paragraphs
Fixed car image on a road line at the bottom of the viewport
behavior: Car horizontal position maps to page scroll progress
Updates are batched with requestAnimationFrame and written to a CSS variable
Car size scales with viewport width up to 600px

props.name: title
props.default: A car that drives as you read

editableByProps: Car image, alt text and aspect ratio
Eyebrow, title, heading and all paragraphs
Background and text colors as Tailwind classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Make the car drive right to left
needsCodeEdit.where: The [transform:scaleX(-1)_translateX(...)] class on the car wrapper
carWidth calculation in the update function and --car-w style
The fixed gradient div with h-px

fixed: Car and road line are fixed to the bottom of the viewport
Listens to window scroll and resize while mounted and removes the listeners on unmount
Progress is measured against the whole document scroll height, so it tracks page scroll rather than the component only
